1  BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ROBIN PHUKAN  ORDER Date : 09.04.2025 Heard Mr. D. Das, learned counsel for the appellant.

This appeal, under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, is directed against the impugned judgment and order dated 12.12.2024, passed by the learned Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT), Goalpara, in MAC Case No. 202/2022.

It is to be noted here that vide impugned judgment and order dated 12.12.2024, passed by the learned Tribunal has directed the respondent No.1, to pay a sum of Rs. 06,05,792/- as the compensation with interest at the rate of 7% per annum from the date of filing the evidence.
Perused the memo of appeal and the grounds mentioned therein and also perused the impugned judgment and order dated 12.12.2024.
Issue notice to the respondents, returnable in 4 (four) weeks.
Step be taken upon respondents by registered post with A/D as well as usual process within a week from today.
Registry shall call for the records from the learned Trial Tribunal.
